title: Elytra Bedrock
description: Cancel elytra gliding mid-air by pressing jump, just like Bedrock.
body:
In Bedrock , you can cancel elytra gliding at any time by pressing the jump key, putting you into freefall. In Java  there's no way to stop gliding mid-air — you have to land or hit water first.

This mod adds that missing behaviour. Press jump while gliding to cancel the elytra immediately. You can re-activate it by pressing jump again while falling, which is already standard Java behaviour.
